artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p$ be a positive integer. A function $f$ holomorphic in the unit disk $\mathbb{D}=\{z:|z|<1\}$ is called $p$-valent (areally mean $p$-valent) in $\mathbb{D}$ if it takes no value more than $p$ times there (in the appropriate areal mean sense). Let $S(p)$ denote the class of functions
$$f(z)=z^{p}+\sum_{n=p+1}^{\infty}a_{n}z^{n}$$
that are areally mean $p$-valent in $\mathbb{D}$. For each integer $n\ge p$ define
$$A_{n}=\sup_{f\in S(p)}|a_{n}|.$$
It is known (Hayman, Eke) that for $p>1/4$ and each fixed $f\in S(p)$ the limit
$$\alpha_{f}=\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{|a_{n}|}{n^{2p-1}}$$
exists and is finite.

Question: Does the limit
$$K_{p}=\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{A_{n}}{n^{2p-1}}$$
exist, and if so, determine its value $K_{p}$ explicitly.
artifact.status_search_result: Web search located Hayman's foundational results on the asymptotic behavior of coefficients of mean p-valent functions and Eke's regularity theorems, which establish existence of the per-function limit α_f for p>1/4. No source was found establishing existence of the supremum limit K_p = lim A_n/n^{2p-1} or determining its value; the question continues to be listed as an open problem in the function-theory problem collection that includes it.

status_evidence.title: Multivalent Functions (Cambridge Tracts)
status_evidence.snippet: Treatment of asymptotic behavior of coefficients and Eke's regularity theorems for mean p-valent functions.
status_evidence.claim: The per-function asymptotic α_f exists for p>1/4, but the supremum analogue K_p is not established.

status_evidence.title: Research Problems in Function Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Compilation of open problems in function theory including questions on coefficient asymptotics for p-valent functions.
status_evidence.claim: Problem still listed as open in the standard problem collection.
